description: TY2025: the SS 246(b)(2) escape hatch. All-dividend income $100,000 (under-20% owned), deductions $60,000 -> base $40,000. Tentative 50% DRD = $50,000 EXCEEDS the base, so the full deduction would create an NOL — and then the taxable-income cap 'shall not apply': full $50,000 allowed, TI = $0, tax $0. (The NOL generated is not tracked — disclosed.)
